steps.content: Hella called out to Hecate after taking down all the "Sinners" in her way.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This isn't working. I need a specific target.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: That mouth! Blast it with the lasers! Don't let it spit out any more "Sinners"!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Why are you lying on the ground? Get up and keep fighting.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I... I can only attack in a cross range. There's no way I can reach it from here.
As the ammo depot detonates, towering flames engulf the ”Bureau“, obliterating everything.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: (Pants) Is it... is it finally all over?
No one is going anywhere until you pay for the repairs.
